description: Parameters of the lithology layer (experiment E14): rock classes of the Global Lithological Map (GLiM, Hartmann & Moosdorf 2012, level 1), the assumed composition of each tectonic province of the geological history (E07), and the rules for surface deposits.

province_composition.note: Assumed shares of bedrock classes by province (codes of world/history/data/history.json). Cratons are split by local relief between exposed shield and platform cover. The shares are geological generalisations (shields: Precambrian gneiss and granite; platforms: sedimentary cover; orogens: deformed sediments, metamorphic cores and granites; arcs: andesitic volcanics and their plutons; rifts and plateaux: basalts and continental sediments), tuned so that the land totals match GLiM.

glim_land_shares.note: GLiM: 64 % sediments (a third of them carbonates), 13 % metamorphics, 7 % plutonics, 6 % volcanics, 10 % water and ice; unconsolidated sediments 24.6 % of land (Hartmann & Moosdorf 2012; Boerker et al. 2018).
